notice.title: Before you add a site
notice.body: Do not submit access-restricted or landowner-sensitive exits. A submission is permanent, even if rejected — the public commons holds openly-known sites only. When in doubt, ask a local first.
notice.agree: Understood — this site is openly known
notice.moderated: Everything you submit is reviewed by a human moderator before it publishes.

pin.title: Where is the exit?
pin.hint: Tap the map to drop the pin, or use your GPS.
pin.gpsFailed: Could not get a GPS fix.

nearby.title: There is a site nearby
nearby.body: Is your exit part of this existing site? Attaching it keeps every exit of one wall on one record.
nearby.attach: Add my exit to this site
nearby.tooClose: A new site under {{m}} m from an existing one can't be published.

details.title: Site & exit details
details.siteNameHint: The object — the cliff, the bridge — not one exit
details.directionHint: 0–359, degrees TRUE — never a compass word

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.hint: Optional — but every value needs how and when it was measured.

landing.title: Landing zone
landing.hint: Tap the map to pin the landing. You can skip this, but a landing pin helps everyone — its absence is flagged to the moderators.

notes.title: Notes
notes.hint: Anything a visiting jumper should know — access, hazards, local situation. Written in your language.

review.title: Review & submit
review.noLanding: No landing pin — moderators will see this flagged
review.terms: I certify that I have the right to contribute this material and that it is not copied from a third-party database without permission. I keep my rights in my contribution, and I grant the OpenExit association a worldwide, non-exclusive, irrevocable licence to publish it as part of the OpenExit database under ODbL 1.0 (contents under DbCL 1.0), or under another free and open licence approved by a two-thirds vote of active contributors.

result.title: Submitted for review
result.body: A human moderator will review it before anything publishes. Track it under My submissions.

correction.banner: Suggesting a change to {{name}} — your edit is reviewed like any submission, and prior credit is never erased.
